detail: The 2026-10-21 production coverage probe (run 39565977314, check-run 119108230359) recorded 'alias lead 1082762: Bovada [CYBERSHOKE, blinkdagger] -> [ex-CYBERSHOKE, BlinkDagger] (not applied)'. title: HLTV world-ranking model resolves DAMAJUANA vs Hacha (1082836) at an exact 50.0% / 50.0% tie (2.0 vs 2.0 points) with no directional pick
detail: In session live audit 39605051244 (2026-10-21T13:06:37Z), fixture 1082836 (DAMAJUANA vs Hacha) had no money-market or Valve-standings row, and resolved on the HLTV world-ranking research model rung. Because both DAMAJUANA (rank #233) and Hacha (rank #229) carry 2.0 points on the 2026-10-21 HLTV ranking publication, the 400-scale logistic transform yields 0.5 / 0.5 (fair decimal 2.0 / 2.0). Per project policy, an exact equal estimate produces 'No directional edge' rather than an arbitrary coin-flip pick, which accounts for the 1-fixture difference between 'resolved' (16) and 'with_pick' (15) in the live origination counts.
